description: 台灣糖業公司「台糖加油站」據點資訊 [fuel stations and oil] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 台灣糖業股份有限公司. 內容包含：加油站地址、定位、營業時間及電話. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 台灣糖業股份有限公司. Its tags are 交通及通訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-10-18 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support fuel supply studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
